options.autofish.title: Autofish Settings
options.autofish.basic.title: Basic Options
options.autofish.enable.title: Enable Autofish
options.autofish.enable.tooltip: Toggles the entire mod on or off.
options.autofish.multirod.title: Use Multiple Rods
options.autofish.multirod.tooltip:
Cycles through all of the available rods
in the hotbar, moving to the next as
they break.
options.autofish.break_protection.title: Prevent Rod Breakage
options.autofish.break_protection.toolti:
Stop using rods with low durability
before they break.
options.autofish.open_water_detection.to:
After 20w12a (1.16), you can only get
treasure items in open water.
This will notify you when your bobber is
not in open water upon reeling-in.
options.autofish.persistent.title: Persistent Fishing
options.autofish.persistent.tooltip:
Keep the fish bobber always in liquid
whenever a rod is in hand, recast when
needed. This is useful for lag issues or
fishing for long periods of time.
options.autofish.unsafe_fluids.title: Include Unsafe Fluids
options.autofish.unsafe_fluids.tooltip:
In addition to known safe liquids, also
test a few unsafe ones, which may allow
some modded fishing rods to function.
For example, this enables §clava§f fishing
for vanilla rods and its direct variants.
options.autofish.advanced.title: Advanced Options
options.autofish.sound.title: Detect By Sound
options.autofish.sound.tooltip:
§6Newer, more accurate detection based on
bobber sounds rather than the standard
bobber movement detection.§r
§f- You must be close to your bobber.
- If other players' bobbers are close by,
  it can falsely trigger a catch!
options.autofish.open_water_new_algorith:
§6New implementation more closely
following the documented open water
validation process on §eMinecraft Wiki§6.§r

§fTurn off to restore legacy behavior.
options.autofish.noisy_detection.title: Noisy Detection Notification
options.autofish.noisy_detection.tooltip:
§6Keep notifying the player of detection
results, regardless of previous status.
Affects the following:§r
§f- Open water detection
- Item rod test
options.autofish.legacy_persistence.tool:
§6Instead of using the newer state-aware
algorithm, switch back to the legacy
§ePersistent Mode§6 implementation.§r

§aNew§f: Gathers various states, counts time
durations, and reels-in accordingly.
§cOld§f: Scans every §e10§f seconds, and reels if
the bobber isn't in fishable liquid at that
instant.
options.autofish.damage_safe_margin.tool:
Sets the minimum durability fishing rods
should have before they are ignored.

Used by §eBreak Protection§f.
options.autofish.recast_delay.title: Rod Recast Delay
options.autofish.recast_delay.tooltip:
Adjusts the delay between catching
a fish and recasting the rod.
options.autofish.random_delay.title: Recast Delay Randomization Range
options.autofish.random_delay.tooltip:
Introduces constrained randomness in
either direction to §eRecast Delay§f.
For example, if the base value is set to
1500 ms, setting the randomization range
to 20% will make the value vary between
1200 ms and 1800 ms.
To disable randomization, set this to 0.
options.autofish.reel_in_delay.title: Reel-in Delay
options.autofish.reel_in_delay.tooltip:
Introduces a delay before reeling-in,
after a fish bites the hook.
To disable the delay, set this to 1.
options.autofish.clear_regex.title: ClearLag Message Pattern
options.autofish.clear_regex.tooltip:
Recast the rod when a message in chat
matches the defined pattern.
§6This is a §aRegular Expression§6.
